snippet.title: Exterminauts - Gameplay Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Do the jobs nobody else in the galaxy will. Go in, clean up, get paid. Shoot aliens, blast them with ice or lightning, and otherwise mop up pests with your friends. Exterminauts is coming to Xbox Series X/S, PC, and Cloud.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom
